title: Google launches 15 free AI tools to boost marketing, design #GoogleAI #AIToolsLaunch #AIDesign
description: Google released 15 free AI tools designed to save businesses thousands of dollars each month. Among them are Pomeli, which generates social media content from website links, Stitch, which converts prompts into modern UI designs, and Google Opal for building AI workflows. Other tools include Antigravity, an AI code editor, and Mixport, a creative AI image generator blending features of Canva and Pinterest. These tools reflect a broader shift towards accessible AI solutions that empower marketers, developers, and designers without heavy investment in expensive software. By leveraging Google’s AI models, users can streamline creative processes, automate workflows, and enhance coding efficiency, accelerating innovation across industries. The availability of a diverse range of AI utilities underlines the growing trend of integrating AI directly into everyday business functions, promoting cost-effectiveness and improved productivity.
